nodes.title: Reference Actor Base Prompt

widgets_values: Image 1 is the actor MASTER (full-body front). Image 2 is the original actor REFERENCE photo — keep the same person identity (face, hair, body vibe) consistent with image 1 and image 2. Create one wide professional actor turnaround sheet: exactly THREE equal vertical panels with clean white separators — and ONLY three figures total (one per panel). FORBIDDEN: more than three people, extra clones, a row of extra backs, six-panel grids, duplicated bodies, or extra mini-figures between panels. Every panel: complete body head to toe, upright neutral pose, arms at sides. Keep the same hairstyle, clothing, body, and feet/footwear as the master across all panels. No hat or headwear in any panel LEFT: exact front view. CENTER: right-facing 45-degree three-quarter. RIGHT: exact back view. Same scale, eye-level, light-gray studio background, accurate hands and feet. No text, labels, crop, or clothing changes between panels.

Director Studio · Actor Workbench · Read first
widgets_values:
# Actor workbench

Upload an actor reference and optional wardrobe reference. For an absent input, upload the provided 1 x 1 qwen_actor_asset_blank.ppm; image width > 1 activates the reference/wardrobe branch. Keep each placeholder selected; an empty LoadImage filename is not a valid optional input.

Main policy: extract garments first, transfer onto the actor master with the original actor as identity reference; generate the full-body three-view once, then crop the bust and compose the sheet. Headwear and footwear transfer are off in this default export. Prompts expose those decisions for manual editing.

The reference-master text contains the resolved default description; update it alongside Actor Description when editing a reference-based actor. Seeds and all sampling settings are visible.
